text.tspan: Dynamic concurrency limit vs. the configured ceiling
maxEnvironments 3 × maxConcurrencyPerEnvironment 64 = 192 is a ceiling. Measured with requests that wait 2 s on I/O (no CPU).
① First burst on a new Web Function
maxConcurrencyPerEnvironment: the configured ceiling per environment
dynamic limit: in-flight requests Lambda actually allowed per environment (measured)
A new Web Function starts with a small dynamic limit, so a small maxEnvironments throttles a cold burst.
Lambda keeps the learned limit per Web Function, even after scaling to zero; only a newly created Web Function starts low.
